bibl.title: Frammento di tractoria o documento ad essa pertinente (PL III/1004)
bibl.seg: Rosario Pintaudi & Agostino Soldati, Frammento di tractoria o documento ad essa pertinente (PL III/1004).
bibl.note: This unfortunately fragmentary 6th century papyrus could preserve the sole Egyptian instance of a tractoria, a document allowing the bearer to travel at public expenses. The text is written in an epistolary form and the recipient is the well-known comes domesticorum Flavius Erythrius, whose full name is integrated thanks to this document. Antinoupolis, prima metà del sec. VI.
